name: alt2obs
description: Import Alt lecture notes (local Alt app or share URL) into Obsidian as page-anchored markdown with transcript-to-slide alignment, per-slide commentary from the Claude Code or Codex CLI, a built-in Synced PDF viewer and note verification against the slides and transcript

scripts.build: node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run build:scripts
scripts.test:dom: node test/dom-viewer.mjs && node test/dom-settings.mjs && node test/dom-pdf-worker.mjs
scripts.test: node test/test-prompts.mjs && node test/test-cli-providers.mjs && node test/test-windows.mjs && node test/test-prep.mjs && node test/test-batch.mjs && node test/test-bench.mjs && node test/test-plugin-cli.mjs && node test/test-viewer.mjs && node test/test-markdown.mjs && node test/test-merge.mjs && node test/test-slide-hash.mjs && node test/test-skill-clis.mjs && node test/test-skill-prompts.mjs && node test/test-alignment.mjs && node test/test-sources.mjs && node test/test-layout.mjs && node test/test-verify.mjs && node test/test-transcript.mjs
